title: Create renderer package seam and generator compatibility wrappers
acceptance_criteria: A new renderers package scaffold exists for the first-cut extraction.
steam_deals_generator.py still exposes generate_md, generate_html, generate_share_html, and generate_csv for existing call sites.
Only renderer-related seams/helpers are introduced; cache, adapters, and orchestration stay in steam_deals_generator.py.
Validation command recorded and runnable: python3 -m py_compile steam_deals_generator.py renderers/__init__.py renderers/common.py
